title: Reported nutrient and water recovery yields across agricultural-digestate membrane configurations
license: CC BY 4.0, as stated in the published article
material_scope: Agricultural digestate from a mesophilic cow-manure and lignocellulosic energy-crop digester; not grass-only and not GreenHub digestate
basis: Source-reported mean ± SD; nutrient recovery is relative to initial nutrient mass, water recovery is relative to initial digestate mass; RO-retentate recovery is a separate stream-specific metric
method: Mass-based recovery definitions as reported in source Equations 1-3; values copied from Table 2 without recalculation
limitations: Reference-only comparator; not a GreenHub recovery factor or default.
Initial lab filtration evidence; extended cyclic membrane and fouling testing was identified by the authors as future work.
RO permeate recovery does not establish GreenHub water reuse quality or legal eligibility.
